test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The first printed ______ of this book came in 1933.
solution:
The correct answer is-'**edition**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option:
 
 
• Excretion: The process by which animals rid themselves of waste products and of the nitrogenous by-products of metabolism
 
• Insertion: The act of putting something inside something else, or adding something
 
• Addition: Adding something, especially two or more numbers
 
• Edition: ***The form in which a book is published; all the books, newspapers, etc. published in the same form at the same time***.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is 'edition'.
 
• Thus, *option 4 *is the correct answer.

 

The correct sentence is:* **The first printed ***edition**__* of this book came in 1933.*
